_note: TOOL router (separate from the brain/LLM router). Capability -> ordered provider preference. Manual override ALWAYS wins: in `ai` do  /do <capability> use=<provider> <input>. Grounded by fold-node/research/capability-providers-routing-2026.md (cited). `ai` reads ~/.ai-tools.json first, then this repo copy. invoke:manual = not script-wired yet (prints how-to); invoke:<cmd> = runs that local command. | NO-DEAD-END LADDER: 1 provider -> 2 builtin (keyless) -> 3 manual recipe -> 4 brain (text form) -> 5 forge (/do <cap> use=forge writes the tool, registers it in ~/.ai-tools.json, runs it). A capability is never answered with 'no'.

google_tts.note: Google Cloud TTS: 4M free chars/mo. Cloud fallback only if local falls short.

whisper_local.note: offline STT, whisper.cpp small (setup-menu -> Voice). Default.

ffmpeg_local.note: vedit = ffmpeg recipes vetted in research/toolkit-vetting-2026.md §4: vertical/subs/thumb/join/duck/loud/desilence + cut/mp3/shrink/gif. `vedit` alone prints usage.

kling.note: Kling 3.0 ~$0.075/s, best quality/price. Chinese vendor -> privacy flag.

notebooklm.note: NO public API at ANY tier (confirmed, 2 Google docs) -> manual/browser only: upload sources -> Studio -> Video/Audio Overview.

elevenlabs.note: GenFM POST /v1/studio/podcasts = real API-first podcast/overview. Paid plan only (no free API).

tavily.note: renewing free tier, no card. Good default for web research.

exa.note: renewing free tier, no card; semantic search

perplexity.note: Sonar API — NO ongoing free tier (paid). Use tavily/exa first.

ai_router.note: the brain router itself answers (free tiers)

jina_reader.note: prefix a URL with https://r.jina.ai/ -> clean text. Keyless ~20 RPM; a FREE key raises it to ~500 RPM.

firecrawl.note: 1000 free credits ONCE (not monthly). Self-host core is AGPL-3.0 -> flag.

trafilatura_local.note: pip install 'trafilatura>=1.8.0'; local clean-text extraction, near-zero RAM

uiauto.note: reads current Android screen's visible text via uiautomator over the rish hand (setup installs screen-dump)

webget_builtin.note: stdlib fetch + tag-strip. No key, no pip, works on ANY android. Never a dead end.

ddg_builtin.note: keyless web search (DuckDuckGo html). Floor under tavily/exa.

pollinations_builtin.note: keyless image gen -> ~/ai-out/. Floor under together/fal/stability.

tts_builtin.note: termux-tts-speak -> espeak -> plain text. Degrades, never fails.

kokoro_local.note: Kokoro 82M Apache-2.0, better Hindi than piper, Termux ONNX ports exist. setup-menu -> 2 (optional, non-fatal if it won't build).

mcp_servers._note: Official MCP servers found (tools, NOT chat brains). Wire into an MCP client, not the brain-router. RAKSHA: each needs an install-script security scan BEFORE wiring — not done yet. fal.ai + NotebookLM have NO official MCP; their community MCPs hijack a Google session cookie -> do NOT wire without explicit sign-off.
